## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py --strict` passes
- [ ] No company, client, or personal data in `skills/` (project data belongs in a project's `PROJECT.md`)
- [ ] Writing follows `CONTRIBUTING.md` (calm imperatives with reasons, no all-caps emphasis, `SKILL.md` ≤ 110 lines)
- [ ] Changed behavior has a matching scenario in `evals/scenarios/`, and the change is in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] If this touches a tool adapter: what was verified live vs. taken from docs is stated
